title: What was the sky like when the camera passed?
summary: The game checks nearby airport readings against NOAA satellite observations at the photograph’s UTC shutter time. In Oklahoma, the airport reported clear below its sensor ceiling while the satellite found cloud across all 49 nearby cells. That distinction makes the pale sky in the street photo visible in the game.
measurement: The same-camera sky color error fell from 39.48 to 25.31 in Lincoln and from 29.34 to 8.76 in Bartlesville, on a 0–255 scale. Cheyenne and Minneapolis had clear satellite pixels overhead, but their airports reported nearby cloud. Both retained their previous sky. An earlier rule darkened the Minneapolis sky and increased its error from 38.37 to 58.14.

images.caption: Lincoln, Bartlesville and Cheyenne. Each row shows the original photograph, the game at the capture time, and the final game with nearby weather observations.
Minneapolis, April 19, 2025. A few distant clouds are visible in the panorama. The two final game renders are pixel-identical.
